t: Ronseal Ultimate Protection Dark Oak Decking Stain delivers a durable and protective finish for outdoor timber surfaces. This water-based formula is engineered to safeguard decking from adverse weather conditions and regular foot traffic, maintaining its appearance and integrity. Ideal for residential gardens or commercial outdoor dining areas, it provides essential protection. The hard-wearing properties ensure long-lasting defence against scuffs and scratches, while its anti-slip formulation enhances safety. Rainproof in just 90 minutes and recoatable in four hours, this stain allows for efficient project completion. One 2.5Ltr tin covers approximately 20 square metres, offering ample coverage for typical decking projects.
